symbolLibrary.heading: Dream Symbol Library
symbolLibrary.disclaimer: These interpretations draw on Jungian psychology, folklore, and cross-cultural traditions. Dreams are deeply personal — treat these as starting points for reflection, not definitive meanings.

shadowWork.heading: Shadow Work Prompts
shadowWork.intro: Shadow work invites you to explore the parts of yourself you may have hidden, suppressed, or not yet met. These prompts are for gentle self-inquiry — go at your own pace.
shadowWork.disclaimer: These prompts are for personal reflection only. If you are experiencing distress, please reach out to a qualified mental health professional.
